---
title: "Get started"
---

The sandbox is a local [Forgejo](https://forgejo.org/) instance on your computer. It has the practice repository, the actors of the community and the CI. Nothing reaches GitHub.

## Requirements

- Docker with `docker compose`
- Python 3.11 or later
- Git

::: {.callout-warning}
The CI of the sandbox runs Docker in a privileged container. Do not start the sandbox on a computer where this is not allowed.
:::

## Start the sandbox

Clone IOSS:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/florence-bockting/IOSS.git
```

Go to the sandbox folder:

```bash
cd IOSS/sandbox
```

Start Forgejo:

```bash
docker compose up -d
```

Create the users, the repository and the issues:

```bash
python3 setup.py
```

The first CI job takes about 5 minutes, because Docker downloads the images. Later jobs take less than 1 minute.

## Log in

1. Open <http://localhost:3000/tinystats/tinystats>.
2. Log in as `newcomer`. The password is in the file `.env`:

   ```bash
   grep NEWCOMER_PASSWORD .env
   ```

## Play

- **The tour** starts on your first visit to the repository. The **Start tour** button at the bottom right starts it again.
- **The quest issue** is pinned in the issue list. It shows your tasks as a checklist. When you finish a task, the bot ticks the box and names the next task.
- **The actors** answer you. For example, the maintainer assigns an issue to you when you write that you want to work on it.

The steps of the game are in the [scenario file](https://github.com/florence-bockting/IOSS/blob/main/scenarios/first-contribution.md).

## Start again

::: {.callout-warning}
This deletes all users, issues and pull requests of the sandbox.
:::

```bash
docker compose down -v
```

```bash
rm .env
```

Then start the sandbox again.

## More information

The [sandbox README](https://github.com/florence-bockting/IOSS/blob/main/sandbox/README.md) explains the CI, the tour and the quest in detail.
